channel.title: The Crisp Counter
channel.description: Kitchen tools, chosen by what you actually cook. Buying guides and new products from a small, honest kitchen shop. Sponsored Amazon links, clearly marked.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: They are not the same appliance with different shapes. Compare these five things in this order and the choice usually makes itself.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quart numbers are the least comparable spec on the box. Here is what to check instead, in the order that actually changes a buying decision.

item.title: How should you weigh cleanup and counter space against each other?
item.description: Both costs are paid every week, and both are usually ignored in favour of features. Here is a way to price them before you buy.

item.title: What should you ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance?
item.description: Multi-function appliances promise everything and are judged on the one thing you bought them for. These questions keep the promise honest.

item.title: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer: what it is and who it suits
item.description: A 6-quart air fryer split into two independent 3-quart baskets, with a sync-finish mode and viewing windows.

item.title: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven: what it is and who it suits
item.description: A 26-quart French-door countertop oven with air-fry and convection modes, 24 presets, and six accessories in the box.

item.title: Chefman TurboFry 8 Quart Air Fryer: what it is and who it suits
item.description: An 8-quart single-basket air fryer with four presets and a nonstick basket that goes in the dishwasher.

item.title: CHEF iQ Sense Wireless Meat Thermometer (3 Probes): what it is and who it suits
item.description: A Wi-Fi connected meat thermometer with three ultra-thin probes, wet-bulb and ambient sensing, and app-guided cooking.
